notes.title: V0.8.1-Pre Released
notes.content:
[p]This is a small patch that fully integrates [b]Steam Achievements[/b] into the game.[/p][p]There are no other changes in this version.
Achievements are now live and fully functional.[/p][p]Thanks for playing ❤️[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Launching in 24 Hours – Don’t Miss It!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]After months of work, weird ideas, and amazing support from all of you — [b]Cumrooms is officially launching on Steam TOMORROW.[/b][/p][p]You’ve seen the madness grow on itch.io — and now it’s finally arriving on Steam, thanks to all the support and love from this community.[/p][p][b]✨ Add the game to your wishlist now to get notified the moment it launches.[/b][/p][p]Why wishlist?[/p][list][*][p]You won’t miss the launch[/p][/*][*][p]It boosts visibility and helps more people find the game[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll be part of day-one chaos[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re incredibly proud to finally share it with the world. Thanks for being part of the ride so far.[/p][p][b]See you in the Cumrooms. Tomorrow.[/b][/p][p]– Moon Loom Studio[/p]
